name: sql-cockpit-server
description: SQL Cockpit Server — platform payload installer test
author: SQL Cockpit

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/prepare-electron.mjs
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
